proposal.hypothesis: Controller-only isolation test on the exact D-000544 bldc_ec45 mechanics: hold all six mechanical parameters at the confirmed-pass reference values and raise momentum_q_scale from the passing 0.85 point to 0.90 while keeping tilt_q_scale=1.0, rate_q_scale=1.0, and yaw_rate_gain_nm_s=0.03. Measured history shows momentum_q_scale=0.85 passed all screening gates, whereas lowering it to 0.75 produced a speed_governor_fraction failure. Increasing the wheel-momentum penalty should make the LQR penalize accumulated wheel angular momentum more strongly, encouraging earlier momentum offloading and reducing the time spent near the 200 rad/s speed governor. The step is deliberately smaller than the 0.85-to-0.75 drop that failed, preserving the stable operating region while testing whether additional momentum regularization improves speed-margin without degrading final tilt RMS, peak tilt, pivot displacement, contact, slip, or torque-threshold exceedance. Success evidence: all_screening_passed=true with speed_governor_fraction<=0.01, status completed, final_1s_tilt_rms_deg<=2.0, peak_tilt_deg<=5.0, peak_pivot_displacement_mm<=2.0, contact_fraction>=0.99, peak_slip_speed_m_s<=0.05, and continuous_torque_exceeded_fraction<=0.10.
